quota.plain.title: Codex quota
quota.arg.description: Output Codex 5h/7d quota and reset credits.
quota.arg.indices: Optional auth_list indices to show, e.g. `1 3`. Supplying indices enables auth_list mode.
quota.arg.current: Only show the currently enabled auth_list entry.
quota.arg.auth: Path to the Codex auth JSON. Default: $CODEXTOP_CODEX_DIR/auth.json
quota.arg.all_auth: Prefer auth_list mode and show every auth-*.json entry when available.
quota.arg.auth_list: Path to Codex auth_list. Supplying this option enables auth_list mode unless the directory is missing or empty. Default: $CODEXTOP_CODEX_DIR/codextop/auth_list
quota.arg.timezone: Timezone for reset, granted, and expiration times. Default: Asia/Shanghai
quota.arg.json: Print sanitized JSON instead of text.
quota.arg.plain: Print the original plain text output instead of Rich tables.
quota.arg.width: Total card width budget; each account panel uses one third. Default: 50 per account.
sampler.arg.auth: Path to Codex auth JSON. Default: $CODEXTOP_CODEX_DIR/auth.json
sampler.arg.auth_list: Path to Codex auth_list. Used with --all-auth. Default: $CODEXTOP_CODEX_DIR/codextop/auth_list
sampler.arg.all_auth: Prefer auth_list mode and sample every auth-*.json entry when available.
sampler.arg.log_dir: Directory for quota JSONL logs. Default: $CODEXTOP_CODEX_DIR/codextop/log
sampler.arg.log_file: Base quota JSONL filename for monthly logs. Default: {value}
sampler.arg.interval: Usage sampling interval in seconds. Default: {value}
sampler.arg.reset_interval: Reset-credit refresh interval in seconds. Default comes from [tool.codextop].reset_credits_interval_seconds in pyproject.toml.
sampler.arg.timezone: Timezone for collected reset timestamps. Default: Asia/Shanghai
sampler.arg.set_interval: Send a new interval command to the running sampler and exit.
